research_question: Does the first half-hour return of each high-activity Asia, Europe or America crypto session predict the final half-hour strongly enough to trade after a separate final-window five-minute confirmation and twenty basis points of costs?

external_mechanism.source: Shen, Urquhart and Wang (2022), Bitcoin intraday time series momentum
reused: first half-hour predicts the last half-hour
predictability is strongest when the opening interval has high volume or volatility
the effect is interpreted as liquidity provision rather than late information
adapted: three fixed eight-hour UTC global liquidity sessions
a separate completed first five minutes of the final half-hour confirms the entry leg
confirmation-bar structural stop and scheduled session-end exit

scenario.context: one of three recurring eight-hour global liquidity sessions
scenario.interaction: the session's first completed thirty minutes produces a directional return whose magnitude exceeds its own prior same-session median

state.SESSION_BREADTH_TSMOM: at least three of four markets share the opening direction and the selected market has high opening volume or range
state.HIGH_ACTIVITY_SESSION_TSMOM: breadth is unresolved, but one market's opening volume or range is in the prior same-session top thirty percent

scenario.confirmation: the first completed five-minute bar of the final half-hour extends in the opening direction, closes directionally within its range and has aligned taker pressure
scenario.entry: confirmation close, leaving twenty-five minutes until session end
scenario.invalidation: beyond the confirmation-bar extreme plus ten percent of prior completed one-hour ATR
scenario.target_exit: scheduled session-end close; stop-first conservative sequencing
scenario.arbitration: one selected market per session and one global open position

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: opening state uses the first completed thirty minutes; final confirmation is a later completed bar; entry and stop use no later information

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in development, year-long stability, July confirmation and the latest pulse advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not alter session clocks, activity quantiles, confirmation or stop rules after evaluation.
